args.sql:
CREATE TYPE efficiency_class AS ENUM ('Excellent Efficiency', 'Good Efficiency', 'Average Efficiency', 'Poor Efficiency');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classify_battery_efficiency()
RETURNS TABLE (
    device_id VARCHAR,
    efficiency_value NUMERIC,
    classification efficiency_class
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        d.devregistry AS device_id,
        ROUND(((ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10))::NUMERIC, 4) AS efficiency_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10) > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'::efficiency_class
            WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10) >= 5.0 THEN 'Good Efficiency'::efficiency_class
            WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10) >= 2.5 THEN 'Average Efficiency'::efficiency_class
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'::efficiency_class
        END AS classification
    FROM deviceidentity d
    JOIN testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
    WHERE d.conntype IN ('Wireless 2.4GHz', 'Bluetooth');
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
